title: Senior Project & Program Manager
location: Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only)
description:
We're transforming the grocery industry
 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.
 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
 Instacart is a Flex First team
 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.
 Overview
 Instacart's Customer Experience & Operations organization is at the heart of how we support the millions of customers, shoppers, and partners who rely on our platform every day. Within that organization, the CX Technology Programs team is responsible for driving the development and deployment of technology solutions that meaningfully improve the support experience at scale.
 We are looking for a CX Technology Program Manager to join a small, high-impact team working at the intersection of automation, operations, and product execution. This role sits within a team of three — two individual contributors and a people manager — and will play a critical role in bringing structure, coordination, and momentum to an ambitious chatbot automation program. title: Customer Service (m/w/d) - Französisch / Italienisch / Portugiesisch
description:
Unser Kunde ist ein weltweit tätiges Unternehmen im Assistance-Bereich. Für den
Standort München suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt im Auftrag unseres Kunden
 Customer Service Agents Italienisch + Deutsch + Englisch (m/w/d)
 alternativ: Französisch oder Portugiesisch + Deutsch + Englisch
 Aufgaben
 Telefonische Beantwortung, Bearbeitung und Weiterleitung von Notruf- und Servicemeldungen
 Organisation von Hilfeleistungen für Verunfallte unter Zuhilfenahme des EDV-Dienstleisternetzes
 Koordination von Schadensberichten, Validierung der Versicherungsgültigkeit sowie Entgegennahme von Kundenbeschwerden
 Beratung der Kunden im Schadensfall bei Serviceleistungen
 Pflege aller relevanten Daten im CRM-System
 Korrespondenz mit Versicherungen sowie Werkstätten und anderen Dienstleistern
 Allgemeine administrative Aufgaben
 Qualifikation
 Hohe Servicementalität - gerne auch Quereinsteiger
 Fließende Deutschkenntnisse, gute Englischkenntnisse + eine weitere Fremdsprache (Italienisch oder Französisch oder Portugiesisch)
 Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Kunden persönlich oder telefonisch
 Kommunikationsstark, redegewandt, kundenorientiert
 Benefits
 Sehr gute Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem internationalen Unternehmen
 Langfristige Perspektive
 Sehr gute Teamatmosphäre
 Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Senior People Operations Coordinator
description:
Location: hybrid, based at one of our UK offices: London, Cardiff, or Manchester. 

The Role

As a key member of the Global People Operations team, the UK People Operations Coordinator provides end-to-end operational HR support across a diverse UK portfolio. The role has primary employee-lifecycle ownership for Strategy & Communications, People Advisory and Corporate Functions, and coordinates onboarding and offboarding activities for Financial Advisory and Management Consulting. As a first point of contact for employees and managers, the role holder manages a broad range of enquiries, transactions and cases, applying sound judgement, resilience and a strong service mindset. The successful candidate will be a proactive self-starter with HR generalist experience who can build effective stakeholder relationships, manage competing priorities and identify opportunities to simplify and improve how services are delivered. 

Responsibilities 

  • Own and manage the employee lifecycle for Strategy & Communications, People Advisory and Corporate Functions, including onboarding, probation, family leave, absence and wellbeing cases, Visa and immigration, job and contractual changes, internal transfers and offboarding. 
  • Coordinate onboarding and offboarding for Financial Advisory and Management Consulting, ensuring candidates, employees, managers and relevant internal teams understand responsibilities, deadlines and next steps. 
  • Manage business-specific onboarding and offboarding requirements, including different contractual and compensation terms, templates, approvals and downstream actions, while identifying opportunities to align and simplify processes.
